notes.title: The Hyperventila Soundtrack is now released!
notes.notes:
The atmospheric soundtrack from the game is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1565460/Hyperventila_Soundtrack/]now available[/url] for listening on Steam.

This includes high definition audio files or standard MP3 files of 10 tracks plus 1 bonus track.

Track List:
[olist]
[*] Prologue
[*] Solar Wind
[*] City Rain
[*] Fluorescence
[*] Mechanical Dream
[*] Danger Walker
[*] Derelict
[*] Lost Element
[*] Through The Vex
[*] Artefact
[*] Gateway (Bonus Track)
[/olist]

If you were a backer on IndieGoGo there should already be an email in your inbox with a key for the soundtrack right now!

notes.title: Hyperventila: The Demo is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35772778/d2854748f1068660d2a0cf689c8f2bf0a5917af3.jpg[/img]


Good news everyone! The Hyperventila demo is live! Get a first glimpse at the world of Hyperventila and embark on a unique demo campaign and free a far away planet from tyrannical rule.

Jump into your Manta Class II Shuttle and stir up some havoc in the Tryon system.

This demo should give you a decent idea of what to expect from the game when it comes out in September 2020!
